lines.en: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
lines.zh: 几乎过了一个星期，那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇。

lines.en: One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm.
lines.zh: 一天下午，她乘小船从海岸出发，遇上了风暴。

lines.en: Towards evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
lines.zh: 天将黑时，小船撞在了一块礁石上，姑娘跳进了海里。

lines.en: Then she swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
lines.zh: 她在海里游了整整一夜才游到岸边。

lines.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
lines.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了8英里。

lines.en: Early next morning, she saw a light ahead. She knew she was near the shore because the light was high up on the cliffs .
lines.zh: 第二天凌晨，她看到前方有灯光，知道自己已经接近岸边了，因为那灯光是在高高的峭壁上。

lines.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
lines.zh: 到达岸边后，姑娘朝着她看到的灯光方向挣扎着往峭壁上爬去。

lines.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
lines.zh: 第二天她醒来时，发现自己躺在医院里。

question.en: Why was the girl in hospital?

words.zh: in the darkness:在没有光线的情况下
